Le château de la Cerisaie photographié lors d’une visite en mars 2022.
Les avions surplombaient les tables et la mezzanine, en mars 2022.
Le château de Fresnes le 24 juin 2022, alors que la fermeture pour fin juillet vient d’être annoncée.
La vente des archives Playmobil à l’Hôtel Drouot, à Paris, le 26 septembre 2026.

known: fresnes-petits: age 18–36 months from official archived page and 2022 report
accessConditions.remaining: Other play areas have no separately stated item-specific age, height or accompaniment limits. General park child-supervision rule is not invented as a ride restriction.

shorterDescriptions.reason: Small indoor play installations rather than rides with independently documented histories. Specific scenery and play content described where visible; service text is limited to sourced function and placement. Word counts recorded in final audit; no padding.

particularlyLimited.reason: Official archived theme list and 2022 closure reporting identify the toy theme, but no reliably attributable individual scene, date or setting detail survived searches.

particularlyLimited.name: L’Univers des dinosaures
particularlyLimited.reason: Official archived theme list and 2022 closure reporting identify the toy theme, but no reliably attributable individual scene, date or setting detail survived searches.

itemTimelines.reason: No individual opening, remodelling or closure date established. Historical inventory combines themes recorded at different dates; applying 1999 or 31 July 2022 to all would invent lifetimes. Park-level closure and article explain overall disappearance. No claims of transfer or object preservation.

referenceImages.operator: Jeux Jouets Services legal operator has no separately verified brand logo/portrait in registry or official archive. Do not duplicate Playmobil park logo as legal-company logo.
referenceImages.founder: No proven personal founder; brand creator not assumed to be Fresnes founder.
referenceImages.manufacturer: Toy brand is not a proven attraction-structure manufacturer; no inferred manufacturer references.

families: Official archived PLAYMOBIL pages and six original photos

generalPhotos.reason: Hall, facade at two distinct angles and decorated mezzanine. Other hall frames are near duplicates, attraction close-ups do not qualify. Wrong-park LotsaFunMaps and generic Vinci images rejected. No fifth independently useful overview found.

importantItems.name: Le Château des chevaliers
importantItems.reason: Wide older scene, official play-table scene and 2022 dragon guard close-up provide complementary views.

importantItems.name: Le Château des princesses
importantItems.reason: Whole palace scenery and close view of pink miniature palaces. Other 2022 frame foreground is a child and pirate toys, with princess backdrop soft/out of focus; not added just for count.

importantItems.name: Le Bateau des pirates
importantItems.reason: Large walk-aboard ship and miniature boats at its base. Mascot/pirate portraits outside this area cannot be counted as a third installation view.

eventPhotos.opening: No contemporary 1999 opening photograph located; March 2022 operating hall explicitly captioned.
eventPhotos.announcement: Actual press photograph dated 24 June 2022 by LP/Fanny Delporte, source and caption checked, imported original bytes.
eventPhotos.closure: 24 June 2022 facade contextualizes closure, not represented as final-day photograph.
eventPhotos.reconversion: Actual 13 December 2023 LP/Marine Legrand photo found. Original 1861849 bytes exceeds 960 KiB; published reduced variant blocked by proxy. No recompression; pre-closure facade caption clearly dates June 2022.
eventPhotos.heritage: No image of a physical donation inferred from collection recognition. Historical facade represents remembered place.
eventPhotos.article: June 2022 closure-announcement reportage main image, March 2022 hall within article.
